description: Build Order Based On Beasty's "BEST Macedonian Dynasty Build Order Guide"
name: S13 Beasty Feudal Pressure / Castle Rush
author: siberian_wolf

notes: 1 @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ If Playing Safe, Queue 2-3 If Opponent Can Be Harrassed
Pasamos 1 de @resource/resource_food.webp@ a construir el Hippo, 1 de @resource/resource_gold.webp@ a madera y Rally @resource/rally.webp@ a madera.

Al terminar el Bastion Varego@building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ manda los aldeanos@unit_worker/villager.webp@ ayudar Subir de Edad@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@@age/age_2.webp@. Empieza hacer muros@building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ de Madera tambien. Quitas el aldeano@unit_worker/villager.webp@ de donde este mas cerca de hacer el muro.
Hasta subir de edad fue mandando los nuevos aldeanos@unit_worker/villager.webp@ a oro paso de 2 a 5. Aqui tiene 3-4 Lanzas@unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@
Herreria @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ y hacer @technology_macedonian/scale-barding-2.webp@ y @technology_macedonian/blade-inlaying-2.webp@ cuando puedas.

@resource/rally.webp@ novos @unit_worker/villager.webp@em @resource/resource_gold.webp@até somar 2. O primeiro constrói @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ e @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@, o segundo termina.
Quando os 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ do @resource/resource_gold.webp@ coletarem 200, envia eles para @resource/resource_stone.webp@
quando as @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ acaberem, os @unit_worker/villager.webp@ da @resource/resource_wood.webp@ constroem  @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
depois de coletar 350 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ todos @unit_worker/villager.webp@ vão para @resource/resource_wood.webp@

quando coletar 400 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 10 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ da @resource/resource_wood.webp@ constroem o segundo @building_economy/town-center.webp@ diagonal a @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@
dos 10 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ que construiram o @building_economy/town-center.webp@, 5 voltam para @resource/resource_wood.webp@ e os outros 5 vão para @resource/resource_gold.webp@

description: Vortix's some horse into varangian guard spam build order. Utilizing the Hippodrome for early cavalry support and map control before transitioning into a lethal infantry based push. Ideal for countering double Town Center openings.
name: VortiX's Feudal Varangian Guard Rush - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: Start @age/age_2.webp@with 4 from@resource/resource_food.webp@ and back to (with 1 @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@ before)

description: Its one of my first selfmade guides. I will try 2 improve it. This one is just a blueprint.
name: Macedonian Dynasty 1v1 Fast castle.
author: eawas

notes: All 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ - 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ after that send him to @resource/resource_food.webp@ - Next 3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ - Next 4 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@
Next @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ and the second one to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Next @unit_worker/villager.webp@ rally to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 10 - after that to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ till 6
ONLY build @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ if needed for Defense.
Only build 2-3 @unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@ + 3-5 @unit_macedonian/bogmadr-2.webp@ if enemy tries 2 harrass. Depends on what he plays!

Keep producing @unit_worker/villager.webp@ and put them on @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@. Wont add any villagers in the next steps because you need 2 macro them for whatever you need.

Age up with @landmark_byzantines/cistern-of-the-first-hill-2.webp@. Its needed for the Attack soon so we can regenerate while fighting (25HP / per second for 6 secs on NON-Siege military units) (If u get harrassed use the @landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ and put it on important things like @resource/deer.webp@@resource/berrybush.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@
Build 2 @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ (if u didnt build the first one) otherwise add 1.
Queue permanently @unit_byzantines/varangian-guard-3.webp@ until 12-18 Units + add other units. Depends what the enemy plays (Like @unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@ for cavalry)

description: Build padrão para quase todos jogos
name: Padrão
author: Bigs

notes: Começa com todos em @resource/sheep.webp@ e @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ busca @resource/deer.webp@
Apenas 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ constrói o @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ e volta pras @resource/sheep.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ novos @unit_worker/villager.webp@em @resource/resource_gold.webp@até somar 3. O primeiro constrói @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@, o segundo termina.
Assim que encontrar @resource/deer.webp@, encaminha 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ para construir @building_economy/mill.webp@nos @resource/deer.webp@
Quando o @building_economy/mill.webp@ ficar pronto, pesquise @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ imediatamente
3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ que estavam em @resource/resource_food.webp@ constroem o @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ao lado do @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Os 3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ que construiram o @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ constroem uma @building_economy/house.webp@ e voltam para @resource/resource_food.webp@
Quando tiver 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@extra, constrói um @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@na madeira ao lado safe do @building_economy/town-center.webp@

Comece a usar o @resource/resource_gold.webp@ para pesquisar @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@@technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@ nessa ordem de prioridade

name: Fast Imp Swaggy Professor
author: Blort
